page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8369HB processors running at a baseline clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It does not contain any graphics processing units. For network connectivity, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high-frequency Intel Xeon processors and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.hfg7.24xlarge offers high compute density. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring high single-core performance and parallel processing capabilities without the need for local storage. Appropriate workloads include high-performance computing, large-scale web serving, and compute-intensive enterprise applications.
